title: Full Body Antagonists
description: Full body antagonist supersets: incline push-ups, 1.5 squats and chair dips for a complete session

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Fast march in place
exercises.instructions: March fast in place with arm swings

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier version

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, arms in a Y shape, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: 1.5 squats
exercises.instructions: Lower down, rise halfway, lower again, then rise all the way

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: On one leg, hinge the torso forward, back leg extended

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, lift the torso off the floor, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
